service.description: Run a mapping: a job on the worker pool (out runId, statusId EtlrPending), or here with wait. The source's rows go through the mapping's fields into the target, an entity (loadModeEnumId) or a service (one call per row). With no batch size the run is one transaction: any error rolls it back, the extract and transform errors are all reported, and the first database error ends the loading. With a batch size a failed batch is rolled back and recorded (failedRanges), and the mapping's stopOnError decides whether the run goes on; with stopOnError any error ends the run Failed, the batch it was in rolled back. loadCount is the rows committed. lastCommittedRow is the last row of the last batch committed before any batch failed; startRow is the first row read, so a rerun from nextStartRow (lastCommittedRow + 1) loads no committed row again. check extracts and transforms only, never stopping at an error, and reports each row's errors, the foreign keys with no related record (a parent an earlier row of the file would create is reported missing: a check writes nothing), and for an entity target the diff against the database (the first 1,000 rows). location overrides the mapping's (${date}, ${yesterday}, ${now} and ${nowMillis} replaced; nothing else); contentBytes is the file itself. With wait the caller's transaction is suspended so the batches commit. The EtlRun row has the counts (written every 1,000 rows), the status, the first 1,000 errors as EtlRunError rows and an error file of every failed row (errorLocation). A DbaEtlRun DatabaseAudit row is written, and a DbaSql row for a SQL source. A ServiceJob that calls this with a mappingId runs a mapping on a schedule, as the job's user.

The first rows of a mapping's source (maxRows, 200 by default) through its fields, for "Load into…" in the grid: each row's rowNumber, its source cells, the converted values by target field, and the errors by target field (_row for the row as a whole, such as a value not of its field's type). columns is the source's header. Needs what a run needs: authorization for all actions on the Tools app.

The target field of each of columns: the same name ignoring case, then the same words (Product Name and productName), then the nearest name within a third of its length; how is name, prettyName, nearest or none. targetFields are the entity's fields or the service's in-parameters.
The saved mapping mappingId as an inline map, with its fields.
Create or update a mapping (its mappingId; a new id when empty) and its fields, replaced, from an inline mapping.
A copy of mapping mappingId with its fields, as newMappingId (a new id when empty), its description description or "Copy of …".
Delete mapping mappingId and its fields; its runs stay.

Create or update value map valueMapId (a new id when empty) with its description and entries (a map from value to value, or a list of fromValue and toValue maps), the entries replaced. Updating needs the value map's owner (ownerUserId, the user who made it) or DATABASE_ADMIN.
Delete value map valueMapId and its entries: its owner or a DATABASE_ADMIN holder.
The latest runs, newest first, of mappingId when given: the user's own, or every user's with DATABASE_ADMIN.

Run runId (its EtlRun fields) and its EtlRunError rows, for the run's user or a DATABASE_ADMIN holder (to anyone else there is no such run). With includeErrorFile, errorFile is the text of the error file (dbresource://moqui/etl-run/(userId)/(runId)/errors.csv, every failed row): the way to download it.

Keep an uploaded CSV or spreadsheet for the data grid as dbresource://moqui/database/upload/(userId)/(uploadId)/(file name), in the content database so every cluster member reads it; clean#GridUploads removes it after seven days. location is the grid's file source.
Whether the user may upload a file of size bytes for the grid: the Tools app's authorization, and at most 100 MB. upload#GridFile's check before it writes.

A file source's columns with their inferred types (number, date, date-time, boolean, text), its sheet names, its row count and its first limit rows (100 by default), from a place the user may read (as an ETL run's file). A sheet is read whole and cached per node (64 MB, by location, last-modified time, sheet and header row); a CSV is read once per call.
Delete the grid's uploads older than seven days and its export files (runtime://tmp/grid-export/) older than a day: the daily ServiceJob clean_GridUploads_daily.
